device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD compact satellite receiver
device.soc: ALi C3503C (chip word 0x3503C000, SDK chip code 0x10050, OTP product 5)

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, chip word 0x3503C000 -> SDK chip code 0x10050): its boot-ROM bootloader inherits $sp = 0x9FE07F00 from the boot ROM, calibrates DDR delay from the ring-oscillator count in the upper half of 0xB8000300 ("RingOSDelay=296.29600(ns)"), prints "CRC Check Result : Pass", and unpacks the 9.8 MB maincode (0x9c431c bytes) to 0x80000200.  Board start-up at 0x80150EBC checks for C3503C (0x10050), OTP word 0x210 bits 20..24 carry product 5, the internal DVB-S2 demodulator answers at 0xB804C000 and the M3031 tuner at I2C 0x20 ("M3031" on UART).  Renders its 1280x720 "System Setup" OSD menu through GMA layer 0 at 0xB8006300.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 53 patched firmware V1.33B7_PATCH (2019-08-13) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi C3503C SoC.
EMU/patch build of V1.33B7 compiled two hours after the official release (maincode timestamp 20190813-192926 vs 173937, unpacked size 10,240,796 bytes vs 10,146,856 bytes).
